manifest.description: S3 URI of the JSONL manifest from tools/cxg-manifest.py

refdata.description: S3 prefix that holds the gene references from tools/stage-refdata.py

outdir.description: Destination prefix for stores and receipts. Write it as s3_//bucket/prefix: HealthOmics validates an s3:// value as an existing input object, and an output prefix is not one. The pipeline normalizes s3_// to s3://

container.description: Private ECR URI of the runtime image

check.description: Verify each store against its source h5ad

all_slots.description: Carry every AnnData slot, not just the Census set
